messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: cfa: correlation matrix with communalities diagonally
parts:
Sounds like you are operating in an EFA framework, not CFA.  I've never heard of anyone considering this relevant outside of EFA, so I'm not sure why you'd need them for a model fitted with lavaan, but it would be trivial to calculate yourself.  Communalities are the sum of squared (standardized) factor loadings, so if you have no cross-loadings in your model, then you can just square the factor loadings in the "std.all" column of the parameterEstimates() output, then use the diag() function to replace the diagonal of your observed correlation matrix with those values.  But it is not available from lavaan output (e.g., using the inspect() function), nor do I see why it would be expected.

Terry
